changes.title: Preserve the latest gift order when reopening manual reorder
changes.scope: Context only: reorder entry/Done and layout controls. Fix authoritative order snapshots and real persistence; the static mockup proves neither.

changes.title: Add explicit Save and Cancel to the custom color picker
changes.scope: Picker Save/Cancel and picker-local draft → parent draft → existing global Save.

changes.title: Use compact widths for wishlist theme choices
changes.scope: Compact centered palette choices and their selected/draft states.

changes.title: Fix gift action sizing and containment across wishlist roles
changes.scope: Equal neighboring action heights, full hard-shadow containment, full-height square normal List images and text density, role-safe actions; includes the labelled enlarged-text stacking alternative and manager secondary-action placement.

changes.title: Fix bulk gift mutation failures remaining after the batch implementation
changes.scope: Context only: approved bulk hierarchy and failure/selection presentation. Diagnose and test actual mutations and persistence separately.

changes.title: Consolidate bulk actions into one categorized entry point
changes.scope: One categorized desktop Actions menu with persistent parent/cascading children; mobile category overview → options → Back with all bulk actions and current/mixed/pending/disabled states.

changes.title: Fix detached selection outlines at gift card corners
changes.scope: Continuous selected Card/List perimeter and separate keyboard focus; use the selection preview control.

changes.title: Reduce excessive spacing between filter checkbox options
changes.scope: Display → Filters: compact checkbox spacing, reachable final rows, fixed navigation clearance and scrolling only when content genuinely overflows. This is filter spacing, not the bulk-sheet header.

changes.title: Show high and low priority badges outside priority grouping
changes.scope: High/low textual priority badges outside priority grouping; use varied-content and theme controls. Keep all required badges visible in real components, including manager action combinations; fixture omissions do not override production requirements.

changes.title: Place a ghost Like heart and count beside each other without badge collisions
changes.scope: Ghost Like over the image top-right in Grid and thumbnail top-right in List, count beside the heart, no circular background/extra image strip; independently centered readable status stickers and recipient privacy.

changes.title: Align the bulk action sheet title count and close button
changes.scope: Mobile bulk-sheet header: selected count once beside Actions, close at right, aligned targets with adequate top/separator clearance. Each current/mixed summary appears once. Hero Settings belongs to #359.

changes.title: Simplify wishlist display controls and move Settings into the hero
changes.scope: Single Display beside the layout switcher, persistent desktop cascades/mobile sections, gear-only hero Settings beside separate icon-only More; preserve the accepted toolbar mask.

changes.title: Render desktop wishlist List items as bordered cards
changes.scope: Bordered horizontal desktop List cards with existing information hierarchy, square thumbnails and contained actions; do not turn ordinary List into Grid.

changes.title: Allow Grid and List switching during manual reorder
changes.scope: Grid/List remains switchable inside reorder; switching is not save/exit, Done stays explicit.

changes.title: Enlarge gift drag targets and document nested-corner styling
changes.scope: Top-left compact grip within a larger hit area in List/Grid; coherent corner inset, distinct focus and safe separation from other controls. Real drag/scroll verification and the sourced auto-loaded styling rule remain implementation work.

changes.title: Default to priority grouping when no wishlist preference is saved
changes.scope: Context only: Display grouping state. Preserve saved preferences and the settled priority fallback; no new visual choice is required.

changes.title: Prevent dropdown placement oscillation and viewport clipping
changes.scope: Context only: menu anchoring/cascades and settings popovers. Fix the actual positioning engine; do not copy prototype positioning code.
